subject: microbiology
title: Neisseria meningitidis and gonorrhoeae: Gram-Negative Diplococci and Thayer-Martin Medium

steps.tx: **Neisseria meningitidis** and **gonorrhoeae** are gram negative kidney shaped diplococci, oxidase positive, capnophilic and fastidious, distinguished by sugar use (meningococcus maltose plus glucose, gonococcus glucose only) and empire (meningococcus nasopharynx to meningitis and sepsis, gonococcus mucosal sexual infection). Intracellular diplococci in neutrophils are their shared portrait.
steps.say: Kidney diplococci inside neutrophils: Neisseria until sugar and site divide them.

vis.alt: Gonococci inside neutrophils gram stain image
vis.caption: Neisseria within neutrophils, the gram negative diplococcus portrait shared by meningococcus and gonococcus.

steps.tx: **Thayer Martin medium** (chocolate agar with vancomycin, colistin, nystatin and trimethoprim variants) selects Neisseria from mixed mucosal flora by suppressing gram positives, gram negative rivals and fungi, incubated in CO2, while meningococcal blood and CSF cultures use standard enriched media rushed warm because both species autolyse and hate cold and drying.
steps.say: Antibiotics in chocolate select the fastidious pair from mucosal crowds.

left.title: Selective design
points: Nystatin stops yeasts, trimethoprim stops Proteus swarming
Modified Thayer Martin and Martin Lewis variants

right.title: Handling rules
points: Plate at bedside or transport fast (gonococcus fragile)
NAAT now first line for gonorrhoea diagnosis

steps.tx: **Meningococcal carriage and invasion** divide starkly: nasopharyngeal carriage in 10 percent (adolescents and closed communities higher, transmission reservoir) versus rare invasion in complement deficient, asplenic, or newly exposed susceptible hosts, serogroups A, B, C, W, X, Y by capsule, with epidemic belts and Hajj histories writing vaccine policy.
steps.say: Carriage is common and harmless; invasion is rare, fulminant and complement audited.

left.title: Carriage reality
points: Conjugate vaccines reduce carriage (A, C, W, Y)

right.title: Invasion terrain
points: Freshmen, barracks, Hajj and meningitis belt

steps.tx: **Meningococcal sepsis** outruns meningitis as killer: endotoxin LOS driven cytokine storm, purpura fulminans and DIC, Waterhouse Friderichsen adrenal haemorrhage (next lesson), shock within hours in a febrile young person with non blanching rash, ceftriaxone immediately after cultures without awaiting LP, chemoprophylaxis for close contacts (rifampicin, ciprofloxacin, ceftriaxone) and vaccination response.
steps.say: Non blanching rash plus fever: cultures, ceftriaxone, contacts listed, no LP delay.

left.title: Fulminant portrait
points: Meningitis may be absent in sepsis deaths

steps.tx: **Gonorrhoea** infects columnar mucosa (urethra, cervix, rectum, pharynx, conjunctiva) with purulent discharge and dysuria in men, often silent cervicitis ascending to PID in women (later lesson), diagnosed by NAAT first catch urine and site swabs, culture retained for susceptibility as resistance climbs, partners treated and expedited pathways audited.
steps.say: Silent cervix, loud urethra: NAAT everywhere, culture where resistance must be watched.

left.title: Site map
points: Rectal and pharyngeal extragenital screening by exposure

right.title: Diagnostic stack
points: Gram stain male urethral discharge specific
Culture for susceptibility and treatment failure
Syphilis, HIV, chlamydia co testing routine

steps.tx: **Gonococcal resistance** is a closing corridor: sulphonamides, penicillin (plasmid and chromosomal), tetracycline, ciprofloxacin all lost sequentially, ceftriaxone dose escalated and dual therapy traditions evolved, extensively resistant strains reported, culture and test of cure in pharyngeal and failure cases existential for surveillance.
steps.say: Every gonorrhoea drug class retired by resistance; ceftriaxone is guarded accordingly.

right.title: Defensive practice
points: Culture before therapy in failure and pharynx
Test of cure for pharyngeal infection
Partner treatment and retesting at 3 months
New agents (zolifodacin, gepotidacin) pipeline by need

steps.tx: **Pili and antigenic variation** let gonococcus persist: pilin antigenic variation by gene conversion, Opa protein phase variation, LOS variation, IgA protease, all frustrating vaccine development for a century, while meningococcus varies capsule and surface in carriage. Variation is their shared survival grammar against mucosal immunity.
steps.say: Shuffle pili, vary Opa, swap capsule: Neisseria changes coats faster than immunity learns.

right.title: Meningococcal variation
points: Factor H binding protein evades complement

steps.tx: **Complement and meningococcus** close the circle from immunology: terminal pathway deficiency, properdin deficiency, eculizumab and asplenia recur in histories, vaccination before complement blockade mandatory, recurrent meningococcal disease a complement referral regardless of age. The organism is a complement assay with clinical teeth.
steps.say: Second meningococcal episode means complement testing; eculizumab needs vaccine first.

left.title: Risk states
points: C5 to C9 and properdin deficiency

right.title: Protective stack
points: MenACWY and MenB vaccination by risk
